name: PT Visi Media Asia Tbk
summary: PT Visi Media Asia Tbk operates as an integrated media convergence company in Indonesia. The company operates in two segments, Advertisement and Non-Advertisement. It engages in the operation of ANTV, a television station for entertainment programming; tvOne, a free-to-air news television channel, which broadcasts news, current affairs, talk shows, documentaries, and sports; and viva.co.id, a digital news portal. The company was founded in 2004 and is based in Jakarta, Indonesia. PT Visi Media Asia Tbk operates as a subsidiary of PT Bakrie Global Ventura.
